mapper.select: SELECT S.SBJT_ID , S.SBJT_NM AS SBJT_NAME , S.KSIC_CD AS KSIC , S.SBJT_END_DE AS END_DE , NVL(S.TTL_GVSTM_AM, 0) AS TOTAL_GOV_FUND , NVL(S.TTL_PRJC_CST_AM,0) AS TOTAL_PRJ_COST FROM PS_SBJT S WHERE S.SBJT_ID = #{sbjtId}
SELECT NULL AS SALES_GROWTH_RATE , NULL AS OPERATING_MARGIN , NULL AS DEBT_RATIO , NULL AS CASH_TO_GOV_FUND , NULL AS RND_INTENSITY , NULL AS ASSET_GROWTH_RATE FROM DUAL

WITH OWN_HIST AS ( SELECT * FROM TFEE_PRED_ANSWER WHERE FRUT_OWN_ORGN_ID = #{orgnId} ), TARGET AS ( SELECT * FROM OWN_HIST WHERE SBJT_ID = #{sbjtId} ), AGG AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN ANSWER_Y = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS HAS_PAST_TFEE_INT, NULLIF(SUM(NVL(TTL_PAY_GVSTM_AM,0)), 0) AS DENOM_CUM, SUM(NVL(TFEE_AM,0)) AS NUM_CUM, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ANSWER_Y = 1 THEN BASE_YEAR END) AS CONSEC_YR FROM OWN_HIST ), TARGET_AGG AS ( SELECT NULLIF(SUM(NVL(TTL_USE_GVSTM_AM,0)), 0) AS DENOM_PRJ, SUM(NVL(TFEE_AM,0)) AS NUM_PRJ, MIN(BASE_YEAR) AS FIRST_YR FROM TARGET WHERE ANSWER_Y = 1 ), SBJT_END AS ( SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM SBJT_END_DE) AS END_YR FROM PS_SBJT WHERE SBJT_ID = #{sbjtId} ), PEER AS ( SELECT NVL(P.PCT, 0) AS PCT FROM ( SELECT PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CUM_RATE) AS PCT, ORGN FROM ( SELECT FRUT_OWN_ORGN_ID AS ORGN, SUM(NVL(TFEE_AM,0))/NULLIF(SUM(NVL(TTL_PAY_GVSTM_AM,0)),0) AS CUM_RATE FROM TFEE_PRED_ANSWER GROUP BY FRUT_OWN_ORGN_ID ) ) P WHERE P.ORGN = #{orgnId} ) SELECT CASE WHEN AGG.HAS_PAST_TFEE_INT = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS HAS_PAST_TFEE, AGG.NUM_CUM / AGG.DENOM_CUM AS CUMULATIVE_RECOVERY, (SELECT PCT FROM PEER) AS RECOVERY_PERCENTILE, TARGET_AGG.NUM_PRJ / TARGET_AGG.DENOM_PRJ AS PROJECT_RECOVERY_RATE, CASE WHEN TARGET_AGG.FIRST_YR IS NULL OR SBJT_END.END_YR IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (TARGET_AGG.FIRST_YR - SBJT_END.END_YR) * 12 END AS MONTHS_TO_FIRST_TFEE, NVL(AGG.CONSEC_YR, 0) AS CONSECUTIVE_YEARS FROM AGG, TARGET_AGG, SBJT_END
SELECT SUM(NVL(A.TFEE_AM,0)) / NULLIF(SUM(NVL(A.TTL_PAY_GVSTM_AM,0)),0) FROM TFEE_PRED_ANSWER A JOIN PS_SBJT S ON S.SBJT_ID = A.SBJT_ID WHERE S.KSIC_CD = #{ksic} GROUP BY A.FRUT_OWN_ORGN_ID

SELECT #{r.sbjtId}, #{r.frutOwnOrgnId}, #{r.techIpmtOrgnId}, #{r.baseYear}, NVL(#{r.ttlPayGvstmAm},0), NVL(#{r.ttlUseGvstmAm},0), #{r.salesOccurYn}, NVL(#{r.rndIncomeAm},0), NVL(#{r.techCtrbPt},0), NVL(#{r.tfeeAm},0), #{r.answerY,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{r.excelBatchId} FROM DUAL
